transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

What finally scared me into making this appointment is that I’ve been having thoughts like, if I didn’t wake up tomorrow, maybe that would be easier. I don’t want to hurt myself, but those thoughts have been bothering me.
How long have you been feeling this way?

It’s been bothering me for a little while now—these thoughts that maybe it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. I don’t want to do anything to hurt myself, but it scares me that I’m thinking that way.
Have you been feeling consistently down, sad, or empty most days?
Most mornings lately, I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling—like all the color has drained out before I even get dressed for work.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in the things you usually enjoy doing?
Yes. I still put out my paints sometimes, or think I’ll go to pottery class, but when I’m there I just stare at everything. The spark I used to feel isn’t really there.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this down and unmotivated before in your life, or is this the first time?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of a specific time before that felt quite like this.
Have you ever had periods where you felt the opposite—unusually energized, wired, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?

Before this slump, I did have a stretch where I felt almost too sure of myself. And I was touchy—I’d snap at people over little comments, especially if my district manager questioned the store layouts.
About how long did that stretch of feeling so confident and irritable last?
I’d say this whole up-and-down period has been going on about two months, since the problems with the new district manager started.
During that stretch when you felt unusually confident, did you find that you needed much less sleep than usual without feeling tired?
I’m not sure I noticed a real change in my sleep. I mean, I was feeling more keyed up, but I can’t say I was sleeping a lot less and not feeling tired.
During that time when you were feeling so confident and keyed up, did you feel like your thoughts were racing or moving much faster than usual?
I don’t think so. I was more keyed up and reactive, but my thoughts didn’t seem to be racing exactly.
How has your sleep been lately since this low period started?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid close attention to my sleep lately.
Have you been feeling a lack of energy or unusually tired nearly every day?
Yes. Even after a full night in bed, I feel worn out by little things—opening the store, answering a few staff questions, or just carrying groceries in from the car.
Have you noticed any trouble concentrating or focusing on tasks lately?
Yes. Simple decisions that used to be automatic—like which endcap to reset first, or even what blouse to wear—leave me standing there feeling foggy and second-guessing myself.
